dedupe_keys.name: gtfs horaires navette de bastia a l aeroport poretta

description: GTFS-horaires-Navette de Bastia à l'aéroport Poretta is a dataset listed in data.corsica open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Collectivité de Corse. Vous trouverez dans ce jeu de données du transport régulier de la navette Bastia-Aéroport au format standard GTFS (General Transit Feed Specification), comportant neuf fichiers (agency, calendar, routes, shapes, stoptimes, stops, trips). Le fichier couvre la période du 02/07/2024 au 25/07/2024. Coverage: Corsica. The portal files it under Transport & Mobility. Its keywords are transport, gtfs, navette, aéroport, CDC. The portal shows 1 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-02-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-data-corsica-portal.
